statement: Affine local henselizations over effective countable C1 fields with supplied finite-tower residue points have exact finite names equality residue lifts and full matrix-kernel algorithms
depends_on: C-BuchbergerSystems2001 Sections4.3–5.3; Stacks00UE; Stacks0BSK; Stacks07QL; Stacks06LJ
notes: Arbitrary singular and nonreduced finite presentations are included. Polynomial syzygies reduce exact annihilators and actual kernels to finite computations; pointed local faithful flatness decides equality. No coefficient-field section is assumed.

statement: Effective C1 affine local henselizations admit ordinary terminating canonical rational Om indices with explicit residue square-class WG coordinates and all operations
notes: Perfectness is unnecessary: positive finite-tower certificates compute radical and semisimple actual End quotients including inseparable residue fields. Canonical finite codes and square-class decisions remove all isomorphism quotients. Tensor and exterior constructions precede full residual Gram extraction.

statement: All affine local henselizations over finite towers of Fpbar(t) at supplied finite residue points have complete ordinary classification including positive-dimensional singular and nonreduced examples
notes: The proved function-field finite-tower algorithms supply every arithmetic hypothesis. Examples include (k[x]_(x))^h, the henselian node (k[x,y]/xy)_(x,y)^h, and (k[x,y]/x^2)_(x,y)^h. No unspecified factorization oracle remains.
